views.label: Origination Happy Path
views.note: Follow the forward-only 5-stage lifecycle from applicant submission to fund disbursement.

views.label: Document Verification Gate
views.note: Discrepancies trigger a waiting state until documents are remediated, or branch to rejection.

views.label: Terminal Outcomes
views.note: Terminal states REJECTED and DISBURSED have zero outbound transitions.

cards.title: Deterministic Progression
items: Transitions are strictly forward-only: terminal states REJECTED and DISBURSED have empty outgoing transition sets
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) validates whether the actor role is authorized for the target lifecycle phase
Every execution appends an atomic JSON audit record to PostgreSQL inside the same ACID transaction

cards.title: Rejection & Compliance Invariants
items: A non-empty string reason is strictly required when transitioning an application to REJECTED
Transitions attempted outside ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS raise IllegalStateTransitionError and roll back
Frontend UI status reflects authoritative backend database state; client cannot unilaterally transition
